get.description:
Returns GTFS stops with coordinates. By default, only returns leaf stops
(stops that have actual departures). Use the bounding box parameters to
filter by geographic area.

parameters.name: stop_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of stop IDs to fetch

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search on stop name

parameters.name: min_lat
parameters.description: Minimum latitude for bounding box filter

parameters.name: max_lat
parameters.description: Maximum latitude for bounding box filter

parameters.name: min_lon
parameters.description: Minimum longitude for bounding box filter

parameters.name: max_lon
parameters.description: Maximum longitude for bounding box filter

parameters.name: leaf_only
parameters.description: Only return leaf stops (stops that have trips visiting them)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

get.summary: List all OSM data quality issues

200.description: List of OSM data quality issues

post.summary: Remove a manual IFOPT-to-GTFS stop mapping
post.description:
Only removes manual (user-curated) mappings. The IFOPT will be
re-matched automatically on the next auto-rebuild cycle.

post.summary: Set a manual IFOPT-to-GTFS stop mapping
post.description:
Creates or replaces a mapping for the given IFOPT with a user-curated
GTFS stop assignment. Manual mappings are preserved across auto-rebuild cycles.

post.summary: Get mapping status overview with optional candidates
post.description:
Returns a summary of IFOPT-to-GTFS mapping statistics and a paginated
list of mapping entries. Each entry includes the OSM stop info, current
mapping status, and optionally nearby GTFS candidate stops.

distance_meters.description: Approximate distance in meters from the OSM stop

cancelled.description:
Whether this trip has been cancelled (GTFS-RT schedule_relationship = CANCELED).
Cancelled trips should be shown with strikethrough in departure monitors
but NOT as active vehicles on the map.

destination.description: For departures: destination; for arrivals: origin

destination_id.description: Destination stop ID (for departures) or origin stop ID (for arrivals)

trip_id.description: Unique trip identifier (GTFS trip_id) - consistent across all stops for a journey

reference_time.description: Optional reference time (ISO 8601/RFC 3339) for time simulation.

has_more.description: Whether there are more results after this page

offset.description: Current offset in the result set

total_count.description: Total number of stops matching the filter criteria

gtfs_route_count.description: Number of GTFS routes in the database

gtfs_schedule_loaded.description: Whether the static GTFS schedule has been loaded into PostgreSQL

gtfs_stop_count.description: Number of GTFS stops in the database

gtfs_trip_count.description: Number of GTFS trips in the database

IssueCategory.description: Category of issue for UI organization

candidates.description: Nearby GTFS candidate stops (only if include_candidates is true)

gtfs_stop_id.description: Current mapped GTFS stop ID (if mapped)

gtfs_stop_lat.description: Latitude of the mapped GTFS stop (if mapped)

gtfs_stop_lon.description: Longitude of the mapped GTFS stop (if mapped)

gtfs_stop_name.description: Current mapped GTFS stop name (if mapped)

name.description: Name of the OSM stop (from platforms or stop_positions)

oneOf.description: Filter by manual-only or auto-only mappings

include_candidates.description: Include nearby GTFS candidate stops for each entry

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 50, max: 200)

search.description: Case-insensitive search on IFOPT name or identifier

has_more.description: Whether there are more entries after this page

mapped_count.description: Number of IFOPTs that have a mapping (manual or auto)

total_ifopt_count.description: Total number of OSM stops with IFOPT identifiers

unmapped_count.description: Number of IFOPTs without any mapping

OsmIssue.description: An OSM data quality issue detected during sync

affected_count.description: Record count affected (for bulk issues like parse errors)

category.description: Category for UI organization (derived from issue_type)

gtfs_stop_id.description: GTFS stop ID (for GTFS mapping issues)

gtfs_stop_name.description: GTFS stop name (for GTFS mapping issues)

match_candidates.description: Candidate matches with scoring details (for GTFS mapping issues)

ref.description: The ref tag value (e.g., platform letter "a", "b")

suggested_ifopt_distance.description: Distance in meters to the suggested stop

suggested_ifopt_name.description: Name of the stop that was matched

OsmIssueType.description: Types of OSM data quality issues

gtfs_stop_id.description: The GTFS stop ID to map to

ifopt.description: The IFOPT identifier of the OSM stop

StationPlatform.description: Platform info nested in station response

gtfs_stop_ids.description: GTFS stop IDs matched to this platform via spatial matching

StationStopPosition.description: Stop position info nested in station response

gtfs_stop_ids.description: GTFS stop IDs matched to this stop position via spatial matching

reference_time.description:
Optional reference time (ISO 8601/RFC 3339) for time simulation.
When provided, departures are computed from the static GTFS schedule
around this time instead of using live real-time data.

TransportType.description: Transport type for both configuration and runtime detection

next_trip_id.description:
The trip_id of the next trip this physical vehicle will operate.
Set when the vehicle loops back (e.g., tram reaching end of line
and starting the return trip). Used for seamless follow-mode
transitions and vehicle reuse rendering.

stops.description: All stops this vehicle will visit, in order

delay_minutes.description: Delay in minutes (positive = late, negative = early)

reference_time.description:
Optional reference time (ISO 8601/RFC 3339) for time simulation.
When provided, departures are computed from the static GTFS schedule.

route_id.description: The OSM route ID to get vehicles for
